extracted.name: Figs with goat's cheese, pistachios & honey
extracted.description: Make the party season stress-free with these simple throw-together fig and goat's cheese canapés. For added luxury, try using truffle-infused honey
ingredient_lines: a few small thyme sprigs roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Arrange the figs on a tray, cut-side up. Slice the goat’s cheese into eight rounds, then cut each round in half.
Gently push the goat’s cheese pieces into the cut sides of the figs, then season with a little salt and pepper, drizzle with the honey and scatter with the pistachios and thyme.
